description: Template for creating project-specific ingestion plans

phases.name: Backbone Ingestion
phases.description: Ingest top-level documents and create the core graph structure

phases.name: Enrichment
phases.description: Add detail nodes and color data to the existing sketch

phases.name: Cross-References
phases.description: Ingest traceability, coverage, and other linking sources

phases.name: Validation
phases.description: Final model verification and consistency checks

globalHints: Always complete backbone phase before starting enrichment
Run verification after each phase completes
Create snapshots before bulk integration steps
Keep batch sizes within recommended limits for the data type
Cross-reference sources should be ingested last
